text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Median over five decision substations and two start dates of the share of an injected change (+3 points from 17:00 to 20:00 local, or a morning peak moved half an hour to an hour earlier) that the day-ahead correction carries on days 8 to 14. Dashed line: the 0.4 floor the plan set. 'Expected' is the formula's answer on a complete stream.'
